patches.value: Use native EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) and encode the product directly in EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n+1)), by initial coordinates and last coordinate. No max-product metric occurs. join concatenates coordinates; T007 checks its inverse identities and the exact squared Euclidean distance formula. Native dimH is ENNReal-valued. content and haus use positive real scales and ENNReal powers; all mathematical uses have positive exponents, so empty summands vanish. Real diameters enter only after finite-scale ediam bounds, with an explicit conversion in T016. Countable nonempty covers use a subtype of ℕ; arbitrary covers use sequences with empty padding. ScaleLaws, CriticalLaws, InvarianceLaws and PowerLaws are proposition structures bundling the explicitly stated N001 assertions: their fields are obligations, not header proofs or assumptions. T001–T004 must prove them. General metric formulations of basic cover facts specialize to the required Euclidean spaces. No additional premise ports are introduced; Mathlib is used directly.
